title: Forever in My Heart
verse_1: I remember the day we met
verse_1_full: I remember the day we met. Your smile lit up the room. I knew right then and there. My heart was yours to keep.
chorus: Forever in my heart, you will always be. Every beat, every breath, you are part of me. Through the storms and the rain, I will hold on tight. Forever in my heart, my guiding light.
verse_2: Time may pass us by. But my love will never fade. Every moment with you. Is a memory I treasure.
bridge: And when the world gets dark. I know I am not alone. You are with me always. In every step I take.
